hardware_settings_source.method: Read-only live RTDE and dashboard queries
hardware_settings_source.payload_status: Controller-configured values; not a new physical mass/CoG measurement

notes: R231 policy-regime excitation (draft, simulation review in progress). One run, one start pose, two chirps back to back with the pinned construction (2 s ramp in, 3 s ramp out, axes 60 deg apart). Sized from the deployed envelope, not from the R187 recording: (1) 0.1-3 Hz (user safety cap; covers the ~1.5-2.5 Hz closed-loop poles and the policy's motion), 30 s, translations 0.3x and rotations 0.5x the R187 amplitudes, so tracking errors reach about the deployment error clip (0.05 m / 0.3 rad) and wrist speeds about the policy's p99 (~60-70 deg/s); the R187 recording exceeded the clip on 70% (translation) / 52% (rotation) of samples. (2) 0.1-1 Hz at 0.2x (2.9-5.7 deg rotations, the policy's 2-6 deg strokes), 20 s, wrist stall torques up to ~5 N m so they cross the ~3 N m fitted breakaway (at 0.1x the R187 model only touched it). Why: R229 found the R187 model moves wrist 1 / wrist 3 6-13x more than the real arm in the policy regime. Start pose: medoid real R214 near-table configuration (R230) raised by IK to a 0.20 m grasp-centre height (same orientation and arm shape; real policy p90 0.18 m). Same controller as the R187 recording.

joint_excursion_limit_basis.method: Maximum absolute excursion of the native R187-model simulation and the ideal-tracking requested path, plus five degrees per joint
joint_excursion_limit_basis.scope: Existing excursion stop guard; not a stopping-distance guarantee.

simulation_review.model: R187 fit_seed3_delay5 (the R214 training arm model; over-moves wrists 1/3 in this regime per R229, so real motion will be smaller)

simulation_review.source_hull_check_simulated: clear; obstacle margin 71.2 mm after buffers, moving self gap 16.0 mm
simulation_review.source_hull_check_requested_path: 25000/25000 solved, within joint limits True, clear; obstacle margin 71.2 mm, moving self gap 15.6 mm
